title: Data Analyst
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a successful and growing healthcare services organisation based in Leeds. Our client is looking for a thoughtful and capable Data Analyst to join its business intelligence team.


This is a role where your analysis has a direct impact on how services are delivered to patients and clients across the region. You will work with operational, clinical and financial data, helping managers understand performance, plan capacity and improve outcomes. The organisation is growing steadily, and the BI team is central to how it makes decisions.


This is an excellent opportunity for an analyst who wants meaningful work in a sector where good data genuinely changes lives, with a supportive team and a clear development path.


Please note: This role is exclusively recruited for via Consula. Applications made outside of Consula will not be considered and cannot progress. To apply, you must submit your application through the Consula platform.


Location: Leeds


Key Responsibilities


• Produce regular performance, capacity and quality reporting for operational and clinical leaders.

• Analyse service data to identify trends, bottlenecks and opportunities to improve outcomes.

• Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting in the BI platform.

• Write SQL to extract and combine data from multiple systems.

• Support service planning and business cases with robust, well-presented analysis.

• Work with teams across the organisation to improve data quality and consistency.

• Present findings clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical confidence.

• Help develop the BI function, including documentation, standards and automation.


A Typical Day


You might begin by refreshing the weekly performance pack and checking the figures with an operations lead, before spending the morning on a capacity analysis for a service that is seeing rising demand. After lunch you could be building a new dashboard for a regional manager, then finish the day documenting a new data definition with the wider BI team. The pace is steady, the purpose is clear, and your work is used every day.


What We Are Looking For


• Experience in a data analyst, BI analyst or similar role.

• Strong SQL and Excel skills; experience with Power BI is highly desirable.

• A careful, accurate approach with excellent attention to detail.

• The ability to communicate insight clearly and sensitively to non-technical colleagues.

• A collaborative, patient style — happy helping others get more from data.

• Experience in healthcare, public services or a similar sector is advantageous but not essential.

• Leeds-based or able to commute to the office regularly.


What You Can Expect


• Hybrid working with genuine flexibility.

• 28 days' annual leave including bank holidays.

• A meaningful role in an organisation making a real difference.

• Generous pension and benefits package.

• Funded training and a clear progression route within the BI team.

• A warm, supportive culture with a genuine commitment to staff wellbeing.


This organisation is recruiting directly through Consula, their recruitment partner.


How to Apply


Submit your application through Consula, including a brief summary of your analytics experience and the tools you work with day to day. We will be in touch with shortlisted applicants promptly to discuss the role and next steps. Please note applications made outside of Consula will not be considered.
